svg.text: Every signal wire is 3.3 V. Only ONE wire carries 5 V: W1, which powers Nimue. Iolaus (LoRa) is powered from 3.3 V (W8), never 5 V.
Nimue makes its own 3.3 V inside.
((•)) talks to Argus by LoRa radio
3.3 V board: powered by W8 from
router TTGO LoRa32, stays by the router
Power only (its own USB or LiPo).
((•)) sends alerts to Iolaus by LoRa
No header wires and no external piezo.
Driven by the onboard ES8311 codec
and NS4150B amp, set up in firmware.
Better close-up photo coming from Taelor.
Bottom-right corner, by the C6 module.
Wire list (find each Merlin pin by its printed label, counting pairs from the 5V end)
W1 Nimue 5V → Merlin 5V (pair 1), the only 5 V wire
W3 Nimue D7 (TX) → Merlin GPIO5 (pair 6), Merlin listens
W4 Merlin GPIO4 (pair 7) → Nimue D6 (RX), optional, dashed
W6 Iolaus GPIO13 (TX) → Merlin GPIO21 (pair 8), Merlin listens
⚠ 3.3 V on every signal pin. Never put Merlin's 5V on any GPIO of Nimue, Iolaus or Merlin.
Feed Nimue from Merlin 5V only with Nimue's USB unplugged. Feed Iolaus from Merlin 3V3 only with its USB and battery unplugged.
METER CHECK 1 (Merlin on USB, nothing else wired, black probe on GND): both 5V sockets read 5.0 V; both 3V3 sockets read 3.3 V. That tells you which row is which.
METER CHECK 2 (everything unplugged, meter on beep): each wire beeps end-to-end. Merlin 5V to GPIO5, GPIO21, GPIO22 and 3V3 must NOT beep.
Camera (OV5647, Phase 3) uses Merlin's CAMERA ribbon socket, not header wires.
